models.name: Crate
models.why: Crates hold the cargo on the trip

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
These are the models you will use. In VR, type the gray word in the Models search box to find each one.

@MODELS@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab too.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Steam in Filter environments. Click Immigrant Steam Ship (Day), then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Load the deck
steps.html:
Walk onto the deck of the ship. Put the 3 crates in a row.

Put one good on each part of the deck: the bananas, the lumber, the wheat and the orange.

steps.title: Take your photo and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until your whole diorama fits. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Put the bananas closest to the front. In the old photo, the ship was taking bananas to Boston.

vr.full: One photo that shows the crates and all 4 goods on the deck.

studio.title: Draw the Trade Routes
studio.look: A map of six places in North America and the Caribbean. Each place has plenty of something, and each is missing something. A cargo card shows goods leaving one place.
studio.do: Read the cargo card. The dark place is where it comes from. Tap the place that needs it. An arrow shows the route.

game.miss: Not that place. Read the card: which place is missing this?
game.done: Five routes on the map! Goods travel from where there is plenty to where there is scarcity.

places.name: Canada: forests, too cold for oranges
Boston: a cold city by the Atlantic
Caribbean: bananas, too warm for wheat

cargo.name: Bananas
cargo.what: They grow in warm weather. Send them to the cold city by the Atlantic.
cargo.ok: Yes! Bananas went by steamship from Jamaica to Boston.

cargo.name: Timber (wood)
cargo.what: Canada has huge forests. Send it to the place with few trees.
cargo.ok: Yes! The prairie is a sea of grass with few trees, so farms need wood.

cargo.name: Oranges
cargo.what: Florida grows them. Send them to the place too cold for orange trees.
cargo.ok: Yes! Oranges ship to stores far from any orange tree.

cargo.name: Wheat
cargo.what: The prairies grow plenty. Send it to the islands too warm for wheat.
cargo.ok: Yes! Wheat travels to places that cannot grow it.

cargo.name: Avocados
cargo.what: Mexico grows them. Send them to the cold city by the Atlantic.
cargo.ok: Yes! Avocados from Mexico travel north to cold cities.
